en.title: Gears of War: E-Day Controllers Emerge With Gruff 3D Designs
en.summary: Xbox has unveiled a pair of stunning, limited-edition controllers for the upcoming Gears of War: E-Day. These aren't just gamepads; they're rugged pieces of art designed to immerse players deeper into the brutal world of Sera.
en.body:
Prepare to grip the grit and feel the fury of Sera like never before. Xbox has just revealed a pair of incredibly detailed, limited-edition controllers for the highly anticipated **Gears of War: E-Day**, and they are absolutely *built* for battle. These aren't your standard plastic peripherals; they're sculpted pieces of art designed to evoke the raw, unyielding essence of the **Gears of War** universe.

The flagship of this release is the **Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition Controller**. It boasts a charred black finish with 3D-sculpted grips that feel as rugged as the Locusts you'll be facing. The blood-red core peeking through hints at the constant struggle and sacrifice inherent in the **Gears** saga. Complementing this is the **Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition with Xbox Design Lab** option, which offers a striking silver skull and crossed Chainsaw Lancers, giving players a chance to personalize their war machine.

Drawing inspiration directly from the scarred landscapes of Sera, these controllers feature 3D molded, laser-etched details of cracked asphalt. The red, glowing cracks are said to represent the raw power of an erupting E-hole, exposing the iconic Crimson Omen beneath the surface – a visceral touch that hardcore fans will undoubtedly appreciate. This level of detail is a testament to Xbox's dedication to creating premium accessories that resonate with the spirit of the games they represent.

## A Fan's Arsenal

The community's reaction has been immediate and enthusiastic. On social media, fans are already debating which controller to snag, with many expressing excitement over the unique textures and designs. One comment captured the sentiment perfectly: "How do you not make them elite controllers? Are people really still out here playing with reg controllers in the big 2026?" This highlights a desire for premium, collectible items that go beyond mere functionality, offering players a tangible connection to their favorite franchises. The price point of $89.99 / £84.99 / €89.99 for the main edition places it in line with previous premium offerings, like the **Forza Horizon 6** controller, signaling that these are positioned as high-end collector's items.

## What's Next

Pre-orders for these formidable controllers are live now, with the main **Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition Controller** and the **Xbox Design Lab** version officially launching on September 30, 2026. The game itself, **Gears of War: E-Day**, is slated for release on October 30, 2026, for PC and Xbox Series X/S, promising a return to the brutal origins of the COG's war against the Locust Horde. An 8BitDo charging dock, designed to match the **E-Day** aesthetic, will also be available to keep your new controller powered up for every battle.

content_raw: Microsoft has announced a pair of highly-detailed Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition 3D-moulded Xbox controllers, which look just as gruff and grizzled as you'd expect. The offering is headlined by the Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition, which features charred black 3D-sculpted grips and blood-red core. Then there's the Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition with Xbox Design Lab, which features a silver skull and two crossed Chainsaw Lancers that you can customize further. Expect to pay $89.99 / £84.99 / €89.99 for the main Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition controller — exactly the same price as the previous limited edition Forza Horizon 6 controller — with pre-orders going live now ahead of its official launch on September 30. The Design Lab controller, meanwhile, will be available on September 30. As with any modern Xbox controller, you can use these pads on Xbox Series X/S, Windows 10/11 PCs, mobile phones and tablets. Oh, and Xbox One. A Gears of War: E-Day 8BitDo Ultimate Charging Dock for Xbox controllers will also be available, compatible with Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S controllers. The dock features magnetic alignment for easy placement, drop-and-charge functionality, and built-in protection against overcharging and overheating. As for Gears of War: E-Day itself, the alien-stomping shooter is out October 6 for PC and Xbox Series X/S and confirmed to be a console exclusive, meaning it will never launch on PlayStation . An open beta is currently available, though some players are being put off by some classic sweaty Gears movement . "The tried-and-true Gears gameplay with my usual combo of Gnasher and Longshot works as well as I've always remembered," IGN wrote in our recent Gears of War: E-Day multiplayer hands-on preview . "And tossing a frag into a Locust hole to nip the wave in the bud is as satisfying as it's always been." Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor.
